key_highlights: ASX closed higher as oil eased to $100 and 10-yr Treasury yield declined; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) advanced on Fed rate hike pacifying inflation fears
AUD crushed after Fed 'Warshach test' failure, creating headwinds for commodity exporters and import-dependent sectors
Iran war uncertainty and Middle East oil shock dominate energy risk narrative; oil at $100/bbl supports WES, WDS, BHP energy division
WA mining exploration surge: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE, Critica rare earths (58% carbonate), Augustus 30g/t gold, Auric Burbanks plant fast-track
IMF urges Australian government to cut spending ahead of another RBA rate hike; state interest costs soaring
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, signalling major infrastructure/tech capex into Australia
Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports pressures WES, WDS and consumer transport costs
Consumer stress: Coles holds milk prices, Cue/Veronika Maine face collapse, real wages crushed by exploited workers

sectors.trend: Big four banks advanced as Fed hike eased inflation fears; NIMs supported by higher rates but credit risk rising with state interest costs and private credit stress
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX benefit from rate environment but watch NPLs from Bathla insolvency storm and housing stress

sectors.trend: WA exploration pipeline strong (copper, gold, rare earths); oil at $100 supports energy miners; AUD weakness boosts commodity export margins
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from AUD softness; junior explorers (Auric, Critica, Augustus) attract speculative flows; gold grades support GOLD.AX, NVA.AX

sectors.trend: Oil at $100 on Iran war uncertainty; east-coast fuel supply crunch; coal policy debate (Albo government); green hydrogen spending questioned
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX, SXG.AX face supply constraints but pricing power; coal policy risk for energy transition names; LNG exporters benefit from AUD weakness

sectors.trend: Coles holds milk prices; fashion brands Cue/Veronika Maine near collapse; real wages negative; backpacker cuts hit tourism/farming labour
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin pressure; tourism names (QAN.AX, CXG.AX) hit by backpacker cuts; defensive staples preferred

sectors.trend: Tenants catching a break on rents; ACCC targeting real estate monopoly; Trump housing comments create global uncertainty; state interest costs rising
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) may see rent pressure but occupancy stable; watch ACCC regulatory risk

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal; AI regulation (smart glasses ban); AI job displacement narrative; Meta talent exodus
sectors.implications: Infrastructure and datacentre plays benefit; ASX tech names limited but CSL.AX, SGP.AX benefit from AI-driven healthcare demand

key_themes: Fed rate hike pacifies global inflation fears but AUD weakness creates mixed signals for ASX
Iran/Middle East oil shock at $100/bbl is primary geopolitical risk
WA mining exploration super-cycle in copper, gold, rare earths
RBA rate hike looming per IMF; state fiscal stress intensifying
Consumer squeeze: negative real wages, fuel supply crunch, immigration-driven labour shortages
Anthropic datacentre signals Australia as AI infrastructure hub
Private credit and insolvency contagion (Bathla) raising financial stability concerns

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iran war escalation / oil shock beyond $100
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; maintain cash; monitor WES/WDS inventory levels
Favour commodity exporters (BHP, RIO, FMG); avoid import-heavy consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike + state fiscal stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in REITs; favour short-duration financials; monitor state bond spreads
Monitor WES, WDS supply metrics; consider SXG as domestic producer
Underweight discretionary consumer; favour staples (WOW, WES)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight large-cap miners on AUD weakness and $100 oil
opportunities.rationale: AUD crushed post-Fed; commodity exporters gain margin; oil supports energy division

opportunities.recommendation: Add WA exploration juniors on copper/rare earths pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Dalaroo, Critica, Augustus, Auric all showing strong grades; structural demand for critical minerals

opportunities.recommendation: Position in datacentre/infrastructure beneficiaries of Anthropic QLD deal
opportunities.rationale: $31bn capex signals multi-year infrastructure buildout; power and construction demand

opportunities.recommendation: Favour big four banks on rate-supported NIMs
opportunities.rationale: Fed hike pacifies inflation; RBA hike supports Australian NIMs; banks advanced today

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and long-duration exposure ahead of RBA hike
defensive_moves.rationale: IMF-flagged rate hike; state interest costs soaring; tenant rent relief pressures yields
Negative real wages, backpacker cuts, brand collapses signal demand fragility

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain 10-15% cash/gold allocation for geopolitical hedge
defensive_moves.rationale: Iran war uncertainty unmodelled; oil at $100 with upside risk; AUD volatility elevated

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate higher near-term on bank strength and oil-driven energy support, but AUD weakness and RBA hike risk cap upside. S&P/ASX 200 (^AXJO) range-bound with volatility from Middle East headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA critical minerals pipeline, AI infrastructure capex (Anthropic), and commodity pricing support 6-12 month upside. However, fiscal tightening, negative real wages, and immigration-driven labour constraints pose medium-term headwinds to consumer and construction sectors.
